[[Calder Nettic]]'s '''wife''' lived with him on the [[Farm/Legends|pastoral]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nettic cheated on her, [[Reproduction/Legends|sleeping]] with the [[Handon Guld's wife|wife]] of another [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] named [[Handon Guld]]. Nettic also cheated a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Rickard Lusoff]] out of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in business deal. The two individually plotted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Calder, although Guld was the one to actually commit the murder. During the investigation, Lusoff claimed that he should be the one to break the news to Nettic's wife.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calder Nettic's wife was mentioned in the<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[2003]]<ref name="KOTOR Date">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]].''<ref name="KOTOR" />
